new_value: Replaced XOR slot formula in python/src/lichen/ccp.py slot_hash with spec 14.7 ADD formula (hash_32(eui64) + (sfn & 0xFFFFFFFF)) % num_slots; matches ccp_sfn_wrap_slot_hash.json oracle (sfn=0xFFFFFFFF/16 -> slot 12). All 169 ccp tests + 128 vector-driven tests pass. Rust TdmaScheduler::slot_for already uses ADD formula, no twin bug.
